$description: Candidate public semantic contract. Values remain provisional until the visual-direction checkpoint.

default.$description: The application background behind default surfaces and page content.
The default bounded surface placed above the application canvas.

primary.$description: Primary copy, labels, and high-emphasis interface text on the application canvas.

muted.$description: Secondary copy, metadata, and helper text on the application canvas.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis separators and nonessential boundaries; never the only state indicator.

background.$description: Fill for the primary action on a surface.

foreground.$description: Text and icon color placed on the primary action fill.

accent.$description: Brand accent for selected or emphasized non-text signal marks on the canvas.

highlight.$description: High-attention non-text highlight on the canvas.

danger.$description: Destructive and error signal marks on the canvas.

ring.$description: Keyboard focus indicator on the application canvas.

0.$description: Removes structural separation without introducing a magic value.

1.$description: Tight internal separation for compact details.

2.$description: Compact separation between closely related controls or content.

3.$description: Comfortable separation within a control group or content cluster.

4.$description: Default separation between sibling interface regions.

6.$description: Section-level separation between distinct content groups.

8.$description: Strong page-level separation between major regions.

control.$description: Corner radius for compact controls and small interactive elements.

surface.$description: Corner radius for bounded content surfaces.

overlay.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, popovers, and other elevated overlays.

pill.$description: Fully rounded shape for badges, chips, and pill controls.

instant.$description: No-transition response for reduced motion and immediate state changes.

feedback.$description: Short response for direct control feedback and micro-state changes.

transition.$description: Standard duration for functional spatial and hierarchy transitions.

standard.$description: Default restrained easing for functional interface transitions.

disabled.$description: Opacity applied to a disabled control while preserving its semantic state.
